mouselock.configuration.title: Mouse Lock Configuration
mouselock.configuration.textSize.tooltip:
Scale of the "Mouse Locked" overlay text, in percent.
100% = default size, 50% = half size, 200% = twice as large.
mouselock.configuration.textHorizontalPo:
Horizontal position of the overlay text, in percent of the window width.
0% = left edge, 50% = center, 100% = right edge.
Vertical position of the overlay text, in percent of the window height.
0% = top edge, 100% = bottom edge.
mouselock.configuration.reactToHotbarHei:
If enabled, the overlay text automatically shifts down in game modes without a health bar,
 matching vanilla item name behavior.
mouselock.configuration.resetOnWorldChan: If enabled, the mouse lock state is reset when leaving or switching worlds.
